physics-h2-q2.title: Dokokin motsi na Newton da ra'ayin musamman na dangantaka

physics-h2-q2.material: An sanya abu A mai nauyin kilogiram 3 da abu B mai nauyin kilogiram 2 suna taɓa juna a kan fili a kwance mara gogayya, kuma an yi amfani da ƙarfin newton 20 a kwance don tura ta gefen A. Nawa ne hanzarin abubuwan biyu da girman ƙarfin da A ke turawa B da shi, bi da bi?
physics-h2-q2.thinking.0: Dokokin motsi na Newton da ra'ayin musamman na dangantaka
physics-h2-q2.s.s1.prompt: An sanya abu A mai nauyin kilogiram 3 da abu B mai nauyin kilogiram 2 suna taɓa juna a kan fili a kwance mara gogayya, kuma an yi amfani da ƙarfin newton 20 a kwance don tura ta gefen A. Nawa ne hanzarin abubuwan biyu da girman ƙarfin da A ke turawa B da shi, bi da bi?

physics-killer-11.title: Tasirin photoelectric da halaye biyu na haske, duniyar ƙananan abubuwa
physics-killer-11.topic: Tasirin photoelectric da halaye biyu na haske, duniyar ƙananan abubuwa
physics-killer-11.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-11.material: Barbashi P yana shigowa a tsaye cikin filin maganaɗisu $B$ mai daidaito yana yin motsin zagaye tsayayye, radius na hanyarsa $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ ne kuma period $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ ne. Barbashi Q yana shigowa a tsaye cikin filin maganaɗisu iri ɗaya da P, yawansa ninki $4$ na P, girman cajinsa ninki $2$ na P, kuma gudunsa ninki $3$ na P. A yi watsi da nauyi. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, radius da period na hanyar Q?
physics-killer-11.thinking.0: Tasirin photoelectric da halaye biyu na haske, duniyar ƙananan abubuwa
physics-killer-11.s.s1.prompt: Barbashi P yana shigowa a tsaye cikin filin maganaɗisu $B$ mai daidaito yana yin motsin zagaye tsayayye, radius na hanyarsa $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ ne kuma period $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ ne. Barbashi Q yana shigowa a tsaye cikin filin maganaɗisu iri ɗaya da P, yawansa ninki $4$ na P, girman cajinsa ninki $2$ na P, kuma gudunsa ninki $3$ na P. A yi watsi da nauyi. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, radius da period na hanyar Q?
physics-killer-11.s.s1.explain: $r\propto\dfrac{mv}{q}$ don haka $\dfrac{r_Q}{r_P}=\dfrac{4m\cdot3v}{2q}\cdot\dfrac{q}{mv}=6\Rightarrow r_Q=5\times6=30\,\mathrm{cm}$. $T=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$ ba ya dogara da gudu, don haka $\dfrac{T_Q}{T_P}=\dfrac{4}{2}=2\Rightarrow T_Q=4\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Idan aka manta da rabon caji sai $r=60\,\mathrm{cm}$, $T=8\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (amsa mara kyau ①); idan aka ɗauka period yana daidaita da gudu sai $12\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (amsa mara kyau ③); idan aka yi watsi da rabon yawa da caji aka yi amfani da rabon gudu kaɗai sai $r=15\,\mathrm{cm}$ (amsa mara kyau ④).

physics-killer-11.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
